describe: Knowledge-base excerpts from the KB fixtures

README.md.text: Knowledge base test documents. Both are original text written for VX Design's tests; neither is copied from a published document. `customer-sensor-module.md` stands in for a confidential customer document.

customer-sensor-module.md.text: Tie the module shield to the host ground at a single point next to connector J1. Do not route the guard ring under the module.
Supply the module from a 3.3 V rail with at most 30 mV ripple.

oscillator-layout-note.md.text: This note covers board layout around the timecode reference oscillator. It is original VX Design text, published under CC BY 4.0, written for tests and as a starting checklist.

Surround the crystal and its two load capacitors with a grounded guard ring on the top layer.
Keep switching regulator traces and their inductors at least 2 mm from the guard ring.
Stitch the guard ring to the ground plane with vias every 3 mm.
Charge a lithium-ion cell only between 0 °C and 45 °C. Stop charging when the thermistor reads outside that window and report it to the user.
